title: Missed Readings override silent
symptom: Missed reading alert does not sound when phone is on silent mode; it only vibrates. The alert seems to use the sound from 'Other Alerts' but does not respect the override silent mode setting.
cause: The missed reading alert does not make a sound when the phone's ring/notification volume is set to 0, because it does not use a volume profile. This is a known limitation affecting several alerts, not specific to missed readings.
fix: To make the missed reading alert override silent mode, enable 'Override Do Not Disturb' for xDrip in Android settings (Settings > Apps & notifications > Notifications > xDrip+). Then ensure override silent mode is enabled for the missed reading alert. However, if the phone's ring volume is set to 0, the alert will still not sound; raise the volume until the volume issue is fixed.
settings_changed: Override Do Not Disturb → enabled (for xDrip in Android settings)
evidence_quote: In the phone Android settings, please go to: Settings Apps & notifications -> Notifications -> xDrip+ Make sure "Override Do Not Disturb" is enabled.
